title: 动物园
problem_statement_md:
假设你正在管理一个动物园。
动物园里的每种动物都来自不同的国家。
以下动物表**Animals**:

![](/content/assets/70ee037d2eb6e671cc9d.jpeg)

国家表**Countries**:

![](/content/assets/6f8f7946b289965d23a6.jpeg)

现在，有一个新的动物进来了，其信息如下。
```text
name - "Slim", type - "Giraffe", country_id - 1
```
请把他添加到动物表中。

并写一个查询，输出每个动物的名字`name`、类型`type`和国家字段`country`，并按国家排序。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Zoo[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You manage a zoo. Each animal in the zoo comes from a different country. Here are the tables you have:
[b]Animals[/b]  [img id="4534" width="100%"]
[b]Countries[/b] [img id="4533" width="100%"]
1) A new animal has come in, with the following details:
name - "Slim", type - "Giraffe", country_id - 1
Add him to the Animals table.
2) You want to make a complete list of the animals for the zoo’s visitors. Write a query to output a new table with each animal's name, type and country fields, sorted by countries.
[note]Recall [b]INSERT[/b] and [b]INNER JOIN[/b] keywords.[/note]

code_templates.prepend_code:
CREATE TABLE Animals (
  name VARCHAR(128),
  type VARCHAR(128),
  country_id INT
);

INSERT INTO Animals (name,type,country_id)
VALUES
('Candy','Elephant',3),
('Pop','Horse',1),
('Vova','Bear',2),
('Merlin','Lion',1),
('Bert','Tiger',3);

CREATE TABLE Countries (
  id INT,
  country VARCHAR(128)
);

INSERT INTO Countries (id,country)
VALUES
(1,'USA'),
(2,'Russia'),
(3,'India');
